properties.description: Serve JSON only. properties.name: awe.security.sso.multitenant.tenant-mappings
properties.description: Optional: Explicit mapping from tenant (subdomain) to registration ID If empty, convention is used: tenant name = registration ID Example: "acme" -> "keycloak-acme"

properties.name: awe.security.sso.overwrite-profile-with-default-role
properties.description: When {@code false} (default), an existing user's profile is kept as-is and not overwritten with the application default role ({@code awe.application.default-role}) when the SSO provider claim carries no role (or none of the granted authorities match {@code awe.security.sso.filter-authority-prefix}). Set to {@code true} to restore the previous behaviour, where the default role always overwrites the stored profile in that case.

properties.name: awe.security.sso.user-name-attribute
properties.description: The name of the attribute used to extract the username during the SSO authentication process. This attribute is typically sourced from the claims provided by the OAuth2 or OIDC identity provider.

properties.name: awe.security.totp.initial-screen
properties.description: Initial screen to check TOTP Default value check-2fa

properties.description: Allows paths for xstream serializer. Default value "java.*", "com.almis.awe.model.entities.**"

properties.name: awe.test.playwright.no-sandbox
properties.description: Whether Chromium runs without its sandbox ({@code --no-sandbox}). Left empty it is automatic: it runs without the sandbox when it is headless, or when the process runs as root or inside a container (Docker, Podman or Kubernetes), where the sandbox cannot start. Set it to false to keep the sandbox in such an environment, or to true to remove it

properties.name: awe.test.playwright.trace
properties.description: Playwright trace of each test (opened with {@code npx playwright show-trace file.zip} or at trace.playwright.dev): {@code off}, {@code on-failure} (a trace for each failed test, the default) or {@code always}. The trace has the screenshots of every action, which cost next to nothing

properties.name: awe.test.playwright.trace-snapshots
properties.description: Whether the trace also takes the DOM snapshots of every action, which the Trace Viewer shows as the page you can inspect before and after each one. They make a run about 40% slower, so they are off by default: turn them on to investigate a failure that the screenshots do not explain

properties.name: awe.test.playwright.video
properties.description: Playwright page video of a test class (the browser lasts the whole class, so the video is one per class, with the start of each test in a {@code .video-times.txt} next to it): {@code off}, {@code on-failure} (kept only when a test of the class failed, the default) or {@code always}. It is independent of {@code awe.test.allowed-recording}, which belongs to the screen recorder of the Selenium tool

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.connection-test-query
properties.description: Query used to check that a connection is alive before it is handed out, for every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). When it is not set, the JDBC driver validation is used. It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.connection-time-out
properties.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, to wait for a connection from the pool of every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.data-source-map
properties.description: Internal runtime state: datasources created from the AWE database connections, indexed by alias. It is exposed by the binder but is not a setting; do not configure it.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.data-sources
properties.description: Internal runtime state: datasources built from the AWE database connections each time they are loaded. It is exposed by the binder but is not a setting; do not configure it.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool of every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.minimum-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections kept in the pool of every datasource AWE creates from its database connections (multidatabase). It does not apply to JNDI datasources.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.properties
properties.description: Internal runtime state: datasource properties of the connection being built. It is exposed by the binder but is not a setting; configure spring.datasource.* instead.
